items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was – Ben Webster was there.

ctx.x: Was that the only European circle? Was that your primary European circle? Was there – did you – were there people in Germany and Sweden and another group in Denmark?
Oh yeah. They were all over. All the guys. I was – Ben Webster was there.
You’re talking about the American musicians that were in Paris. Was that the base of the expatriate jazz community at that point? Or were there other pockets?
